title: UI Tips by @detaildotdesign: Most interfaces put the badge in the top-right corner of every icon. B
notes:
Most interfaces put the badge in the top-right corner of every icon. Better: let each icon choose. A cart has wheels at the bottom, so top right. A person has nothing at the top right, so bottom right.

Designer: @detaildotdesign. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
